label: lem:topological-mass-holonomy
title: Descended term is the unknot-core holonomy
html:
Lemma. Descended term is the unknot-core holonomy

Consider the topological blow-up decomposition \Sigma = \Sigma_0 \cup \bigcup_{i=1}^N D_i, where \Sigma_0 forms a disc spanning the unknot core \varrho_0 and each D_i forms the exceptional disc at the i-th blow-up. Under this decomposition, the descended term equals the unknot-core holonomy:

  \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_\Sigma \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)
  =
  \mathrm{Hol}_{\nabla_A}\!\bigl(\varrho_0; \mathfrak{G}\bigr).
